scope_note: Official sources screened for additional Belfast architecture/development milestones from 2008-2026. These audits support candidate triage only; geometry and licence reuse need review before ingestion.

source_audits.source_name: Planning Appeals Commission NI case search and appeal detail pages
source_audits.publisher: Planning Appeals Commission / Planning and Water Appeals Commissions
source_audits.coverage_used: Belfast and LA04-associated appeal records with decision dates from 2009 through 2026.
source_audits.geographic_coverage: Northern Ireland, filtered manually to Belfast-addressed cases.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: PAC pages present official public-sector material and Crown copyright/terms notices. Candidate extraction stores factual metadata and links only; check exact reuse terms before republishing substantial text or PDFs.
source_audits.reliability: High for appeal reference, appeal decision status, decision date and submitted description as displayed in the official case register.
source_audits.limitations: PAC appeal outcomes are planning process events only. They do not show construction start, completion, occupation, abandonment, later amendments or the final built form. Locations are text addresses; no authoritative geometry was extracted in this pass.
source_audits.recommendation: Keep as candidate evidence for appeal_decision milestones. Before import, retrieve attached decision notices where material, reconcile against the NI Planning Portal application record and replace manual points with authoritative site geometry.

source_audits.source_name: Department for Communities public realm, regeneration, consultation and development brief pages
source_audits.source_type: official department news, consultation and publication pages
source_audits.coverage_used: Selected Belfast regeneration/public realm milestones from 2020-2026.
source_audits.geographic_coverage: Belfast city centre, Queen's Quay, Crumlin Road, Shankill Road and Albertbridge/Carnforth sites.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: NI government pages typically carry Crown copyright and Open Government Licence-style notices for public sector information, but each page/PDF should be checked before reuse.
source_audits.reliability: High for publication, consultation launch, development brief and preferred-developer milestones stated by DfC.
source_audits.limitations: Consultations, development briefs and preferred-developer announcements are not completion or opening evidence. Some pages have PDFs or supporting files that may contain more exact boundaries but were not fully geocoded here.
source_audits.recommendation: Use for design_consultation, development_procurement, development_brief and plan_launch milestones with cautious wording. Do not use these records to claim delivery outcomes unless paired with a later official completion/opening source.

source_audits.source_name: Lagan Pedestrian and Cycle Bridge official project and news pages
source_audits.source_type: official infrastructure project page and department news
source_audits.coverage_used: Planning approval, funding allocation and preliminary works milestones for the proposed Lagan pedestrian and cycle bridge.
source_audits.geographic_coverage: River Lagan crossing area between Ormeau Embankment and the Gasworks/Sirocco side of Belfast.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: DfI official pages; check Crown copyright/OGL notices on page and attachments before reuse.
source_audits.reliability: High for the stated project-stage milestones on official DfI pages.
source_audits.limitations: No completion or opening was recorded from these pages. Geometry is approximate corridor-level only.
source_audits.recommendation: Keep as separate planning_decision, funding and pre_construction_investigation milestones. Do not merge into a single delivered-project event.

source_audits.source_name: Casement Park call-in and notice-of-opinion pages
source_audits.publisher: Department for Infrastructure and Northern Ireland Executive
source_audits.coverage_used: Casement Park planning call-in and notice of opinion to approve milestones.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: Official NI government pages; check Crown copyright/OGL terms before reuse beyond factual metadata.
source_audits.reliability: High for planning process stage and announcement date.
source_audits.limitations: Call-in and notice-of-opinion records are not construction, completion or opening evidence.
source_audits.recommendation: Use only as planning_process/planning_decision candidate milestones, with later official evidence required for built status.

source_audits.source_name: Belfast tidal flood alleviation scheme contract announcement
source_audits.coverage_used: 2021 contract award/funding milestone for Belfast tidal flood alleviation works.
source_audits.geographic_coverage: Belfast tidal/river frontage areas described by DfI.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: DfI official page; check Crown copyright/OGL terms before reuse.
source_audits.reliability: High for contract award announcement and named scheme.
source_audits.limitations: The record does not by itself document completion, flood-risk reduction, asset performance or final as-built locations.
source_audits.recommendation: Keep as a funding_contract milestone only. Pair with later official completion/as-built sources before creating physical-change events.

source_audits.coverage_used: 2020 publication/design milestone for Bedford Street pilot public realm changes.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: DfI official publication; check page and document licensing before reuse.
source_audits.reliability: Moderate to high for the publication/design-stage record.
source_audits.limitations: A pilot publication is not a completion, permanency or performance claim. The candidate uses an approximate street point.
source_audits.recommendation: Use as a design/pilot milestone pending fuller review of the attached publication and any later delivery records.

source_audits.source_name: Belfast Region City Deal official project and news pages
source_audits.coverage_used: Selected 2022-2025 design, funding, contractor/construction and opening milestones for Belfast-region innovation projects located in Belfast.
source_audits.geographic_coverage: Queen's University Belfast innovation centres and Studio Ulster at Belfast Harbour Studios/Giant's Park area.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: BRCD website reuse terms were not fully audited in this pass. Store factual metadata and links only until licensing is confirmed.
source_audits.reliability: High for City Deal programme-stage announcements; exact project delivery details may need corroboration from university, council or department pages.
source_audits.limitations: Economic impact and innovation-capacity claims were deliberately not retained. Candidate geometry is approximate, and some project locations span campuses or industrial estates.
source_audits.recommendation: Use for funding, design, construction_start and opening milestones where the page expressly states the stage. Corroborate with landowner/university pages before import when possible.

source_audits.source_name: Manual approximate Belfast geocoding used for triage
source_audits.coverage_used: Approximate latitude/longitude points assigned from named streets, sites or project corridors.
source_audits.licence_or_terms: No external geocoder output is asserted as source data here; coordinates are rough triage aids.
source_audits.reliability: Low to moderate depending on specificity of the official address.
source_audits.limitations: Coordinates are not authoritative boundaries. They should not be used for precise parcel matching, distance calculations or map claims.
source_audits.recommendation: Replace all manual points with official planning polygons, site boundaries, OSNI-compatible geometry, or reviewed internal geometry before production import.
